meta.title_index: VoiceTale — bedtime stories in your own voice
meta.desc_index: Record fairy tales in your own voice, so your child can fall asleep to your bedtime story even on the nights you can't be there. No AI, no synthetic voices, private by design.
meta.desc_privacy: What VoiceTale stores, where it lives, and what it will never do. No servers, no accounts, no analytics, no ads.

hero.kicker: An iPhone app for your family
hero.h1b: VoiceTale is for the nights you can't.
hero.lead: Record fairy tales in your own voice and let your child fall asleep to your bedtime story — whether you're travelling, working late, or far away. No AI. No synthetic voices. Just you.
hero.badge_cta: Coming soon to the App Store
hero.badge_note: Completely free · No ads · No tracking

promises.title: Three promises the whole app is built around
promises.p1_t: The parent's voice is the product
promises.p1_b: No synthetic voices, no text-to-speech, no AI-generated audio. Ever. What your child hears is exactly you.
promises.p2_b: Recordings sync only across your own devices through your private iCloud. No VoiceTale servers, no accounts beyond your Apple ID. If iCloud is unavailable, everything stays safely on your device.
promises.p3_b: VoiceTale offers comfort and ritual — it never claims to replace you being there. When you can read to your child in person, do.

how.title: From your voice to their goodnight
how.s1_b: Pick a tale from the catalog or write your own, and read it aloud. Recording is made for a tired parent: open the app and capture, no setup.
how.s2_b: Your recordings live on your device and, if you use iCloud, in your own private iCloud — so tonight's story is on every family device that shares it.
how.s3_b: In the dark bedroom, playback is audio-led and needs no interaction: the story keeps playing, and a sleep timer can fade the room to silence.

sounds.title: Sounds made for falling asleep
sounds.lead: Dark player, seamless loops, a sleep timer that fades the night away. The sounds ship from the app's own bundle — nothing streams in, nothing streams out.
sounds.timer_t: A sleep timer that knows when to stop
sounds.timer_b: Set the player for 5, 15, 30 or 60 minutes: the sound loops until it's time to fade out, without a single tap needed in the dark.
sounds.import_b: Any audio you love (m4a, mp3, wav, caf, aiff — under 50 MB) can live next to the built-in sounds and travel across devices with the rest of your library.

personas.title: One app, two kinds of tired
personas.parent_b: Often tired, standing, short on time. The app gets out of the way: from opening it to recording takes seconds. No setup, no accounts, no guilt.
personas.child_b: In a dark bedroom, possibly already drowsy. Dark-first visuals, audio-led playback, and nothing that needs tapping to keep the story going.

science.title: Why a parent's voice matters
science.i1_b: Children recognize a parent's voice from less than a second of sound, and that voice alone can lower stress and release the same bonding response as being held in person.
science.i2_b: A consistent bedtime routine measurably speeds how quickly children fall asleep and reduces night wakings — often within the first few nights.
science.footnote: Plain-language summaries of published research on parent–infant voice recognition and bedtime routines. The full citations live in the app, under About.

privacy.title: Everything stays where it belongs
privacy.s1_b: The audio your child hears is only, ever, what you recorded.
privacy.s2_b: Recordings sync through your own private iCloud. There are no VoiceTale servers and no accounts.
privacy.s3_t: No tracking, no ads, no analytics
privacy.s3_b: No third-party SDKs, no advertising identifiers, nothing watching what you record.
privacy.s4_b: If iCloud is off or unreachable, the app works fully on-device and syncs later.
privacy.cta_hint: The short version: we can't see your data because we never receive it.

indie.title: Built by one parent — not a company
indie.body: VoiceTale was built by a single indie developer, solving a real problem — the same one you have. There's no team, no funding, no safety net. If it gives your child one extra bedtime story on a night you couldn't be there, that's what it's for.

privacy_page.title: Privacy Policy
privacy_page.intro: VoiceTale was built to keep your family's voice private. Here is exactly what it stores and where it goes — and everything it will never do.
privacy_page.who_published: VoiceTale — the app — is published by
privacy_page.in_short_1: Your recordings stay yours: they are stored on your device and, if iCloud is on, in your private iCloud.
privacy_page.in_short_2: We have no servers, accounts, ads, analytics or third-party SDKs. We do not collect, see or sell any of your data.
privacy_page.in_short_3: We use no synthetic voices or AI: the audio is only what you record.
privacy_page.data_t: What data the app handles, and where it lives
privacy_page.data_r1a: Story audio recordings, titles, folders, tags
privacy_page.data_r1c: On your device; with iCloud on, also in your private iCloud (CloudKit private database)
privacy_page.data_r2a: Story texts you write or paste
privacy_page.data_r3a: Sounds you import from your files
privacy_page.data_note: Data in iCloud lives in your Apple account and is managed by Apple under its terms; the developer has no access to it. If iCloud is off or unavailable, the app works on the device only and syncs when iCloud is available again.
privacy_page.mic_p: The app uses the microphone only while you record. If you leave the app during a recording it keeps recording in the background, and iOS shows the microphone indicator and a Live Activity with Pause/Finish controls. You can revoke the permission in Settings. Audio is never sent to us or to anyone else.
privacy_page.dont_p: We don't track your activity, build profiles, use advertising identifiers, share data with third parties, or access your location, photos or contacts. The app reads the clipboard only when you explicitly tap Paste.
privacy_page.children_p: VoiceTale is designed for a parent to record stories that a child then listens to. The app does not collect data from children and has no accounts, ads, external links or purchases offered to the child. The data is the parent's, on the parent's device.
privacy_page.retain_p: You stay in control: delete a story or sound in the app and it disappears from the device and, through iCloud, from your other devices. Uninstalling removes local data; to also delete iCloud data go to Settings › your name › iCloud › Manage Storage › VoiceTale. We keep no copies because we receive no data.
privacy_page.diag_p: If you turned on Share Analytics in iOS settings, Apple may give us anonymous, aggregated crash reports. They do not contain your recordings.
privacy_page.rights_p: Because we neither receive nor keep your personal data, you access, export, correct and delete it directly in the app and in iCloud settings. For any question write to the contact address above; we reply within 30 days. You may also contact your local data protection authority.
privacy_page.purch_p: VoiceTale is completely free — every feature, every story, every sound. Version 1.0 contains no in-app purchases. If purchases are ever introduced, payment will be handled entirely by Apple through the App Store, and we receive no payment data.
privacy_page.changes_p: If the way the app handles data changes, we will update this page and the date above, and flag important changes in the app.

support_page.title: Support
support_page.intro: VoiceTale is a small, honest app. Hopefully it just works — but when it doesn't, here are the answers to the questions we expect the most.
support_page.coming_a: VoiceTale is being prepared for the App Store. This page will carry the download link the day it launches.
support_page.q2a: No. The app runs entirely on your device. If you use iCloud, your recordings sync across your own devices automatically — there is no VoiceTale account to create, ever.
support_page.q3a: On your device first, and in your own private iCloud if you're signed in. They are never sent to any VoiceTale server, because there are no VoiceTale servers.
support_page.q4q: Which audio files can I import as sleep sounds?
support_page.q4a: m4a, mp3, wav, caf and aiff files up to 50 MB. Imported sounds sit next to the built-in ones and sync like the rest of your library.
support_page.q5q: How do I delete my data?
support_page.q5a: Delete any story or sound in the app and it's gone — from the device and, through iCloud, from your other devices. Uninstalling removes local data; the iCloud copy is managed from Settings › your name › iCloud › Manage Storage.
support_page.q6q: Can I play my recordings on another device?
support_page.q6a: Yes — that's the point. Anything you record is available on every device signed in to the same iCloud account, for the parent and child personas alike.
support_page.contact_b: For anything else — feedback, a bug, or a bedtime story you'd like to see in the catalog — write to
support_page.contact_hint: We answer within a few days, usually after bedtime.
